design_strategy: A high-visibility 'Tactical' look for sports betting. Deep Obsidian base, Pure White data clarity, and Azzurri Blue/Neon Green triggers. Focus on high-contrast accessibility, token-based theming, and streamlined interaction patterns.

headings.strategy: Strong Condensed Sans for a heavy-weight athletic feel. Use uppercase, tight letter spacing.

body.strategy: Clean Geometric Sans with increased tracking for legibility on dense data views.

layouts.spacing_strategy: Generous Spacing for outer containers (p-6, p-8), high density for data grids (gap-4).
layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4. Every pixel utilized.
layouts.cards: Sharp edges (rounded-sm or rounded-none). Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-white/10), NO shadow.
layouts.navigation: Mobile-first bottom navigation bar using Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/80 border-t border-white/10).

components.buttons: Tactical Minimalism. Sharp corners (rounded-sm). High saturation for primary actions. Hover state must explicitly set text color.
components.bet_toggles: For 1/X/2 options, use segmented controls with pure white text and Neon Green (#00FF66) active state backgrounds or borders.
components.badges: For 'Prossimamente', use uppercase, tiny text (text-xs), tracking-[0.2em], with a muted background.
components.lists: Dense lists for Calendar and Players. 1px bottom border to separate rows.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use ONLY for Sticky Headers, Bottom Nav, and Modals. Higher opacity (bg-black/60) + heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl) + 1px delicate inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on the main background to prevent digital flatness.

motion.interactions: Fast, snappy micro-interactions. No slow floats.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition-colors duration-200), NEVER transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for body text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

login_background.description: Dynamic action during a nighttime football match with players competing intensely on the field. Use with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/70).

stadium_atmosphere.description: A crowded soccer stadium under bright lights at night. Good for dashboard headers or banners.

football_abstract.description: A soccer ball resting on a grass field at nightfall. Useful for generic empty states.

3d_libraries.strategy: Not required. Focus on high-performance 2D density suitable for mobile PWA betting apps.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a hybrid fullstack PWA. The UI MUST be in Italian.
Replicate 'Schedina Bar' functionalities: Login, Dashboard (4 games), Tiket, Survival, Calendar, Players.
ScoreAndLive and FantaGiornata MUST be visually present on the dashboard but inactive, clearly marked with a 'Prossimamente' banner/badge.
Use standard React web app structure (NOT React Native/Expo).
Avoid generic Tailwind templates. Apply the 'Performance Pro' archetype precisely.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings; apply 'Bebas Neue' or similar condensed sans.
Implement Shadcn UI for forms, toggles, dialogs, but strip Vercel-look to match the tactical dark theme.
Ensure the layout is highly mobile-optimized (Mobile-first responsive).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds without blur/scrim for text readability.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all).
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
